preconditions: Owned native Linux project with checked journal, released original writer lock and a transaction-bound recovery lock; synthetic explicit host authorization.
steps: Complete a full target or roll back a partial publication; verify immutable authority-attributed action evidence.
Discard an unpublished preparation and check its receipt link to retained audit bytes.
Explicitly archive terminal work; verify action, journal, intent and complete retained file-inventory bindings.
Retry under a second authorized caller without replacing the first audit attribution; refuse conflicting existing evidence.

oracle.requirement_contract: Jede ausgeführte Recovery-Aktion MUSS einen unveränderbaren lokalen Auditdatensatz einschließlich der für Restore nach Kapitel 10.7.1 gebundenen Quellen-, Erhaltungs- und Zielinventur erzeugen.
oracle.scope: Terminal action evidence for explicit complete-target recovery, rollback, unpublished discard and selected work cleanup under native locks. Hash consistency is not authentication. Restore source/preservation/target inventories and complete interrupted-action coverage are not implemented here.

open_items: Interrupted terminal receipt/audit/archive writes and orphan-lock takeover remain AUDIT-REC-02.R/C and subsequent audited fixes.
Restore and its qualified source, preservation and target inventories remain assigned to the later restore implementation; no complete SR-REQ-0462 acceptance is claimed.
